text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains and losses are not enough to judge a strategy; I should focus on a plan that fits my ten-year goal rather than react to short-term price moves.","Buying all five stocks gave me some diversification, but I should check that my holdings are balanced and avoid letting one stock, like Stock D, become too large.","I should invest regularly while keeping enough cash for future opportunities, and make each trade deliberately instead of chasing a recent price rise."]}
